purpose: Materialize exact family-linked repeat nucleotide sequences and official/predicted protein amino-acid sequences for the frozen 12 E2A/E3C families.
selection_policy: No family membership, DNA score, rank, threshold, or E3C review tier is changed.
gate_policy: PASS requires all E3C1 priority families to recover at least one family-linked protein AA sequence and at least one family-linked repeat DNA sequence. Other families may remain partial and are retained.
claim_boundary: Sequence recovery enables downstream MSA/homology/synteny analyses; sequence recovery or no-hit evidence is not ART identity, novelty, function, or wet-lab proof.
